description: Code-switching set: one speaker mixing languages inside one sentence, recorded in a real voice (not synthesized). Slices name the language pair, base language first: ru-en is Russian with English words dropped in, en-ru is the reverse, uk-en is Ukrainian with English. References are written the way the words were spoken: English words in Latin, Russian and Ukrainian in Cyrillic.
